entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one independent orthographic source image for a Tripo four-view reconstruction of a combat miniature base. This is a single object, upright like a thin plaque, with its normal playing TOP face pointing directly toward the FRONT camera. Pure solid white background, even neutral studio illumination, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no inset, no multiple views, no human or creature, no selection glow. Show the entire object, perfectly centered, with identical scale across its four views. One square 1536x1536 image. Photorealistic stone and aged bronze material, faithful to the approved concept. This input orientation is temporary; it must not change the final object's geometry. Keep a flat unobstructed center and exactly SIX outer divisions. No spikes, inscriptions, raised center, plinth, feet, sockets or extra decorations.
Input image 1 is the approved Base 02 look reference only: use its dark gray flat stone center, amber recessed groove and aged bronze peripheral frame; ignore its photographic angle, background and inset. Primary request: EXACT FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC VIEW of the upright ROUNDED RECTANGULAR base, directly perpendicular to its top face. Width 0.96 m, vertical length 1.18 m, physical depth only 0.04 m. Height fills 80% of the square canvas, width is exactly 0.96/1.18 of that height. The long axis is vertical. Clearly rounded corners, matching the approved silhouette. Its full dark gray empty flat top is visible, with subtle flat stone cracks. A narrow amber groove and thin bronze frame around its perimeter, with exactly SIX divisions: four short diagonal separators near the four rounded corners and one separator at the midpoint of each long vertical side. No other separator marks. No sidewall visible other than a tiny symmetric perimeter bevel. Camera zero yaw, zero pitch, no perspective foreshortening.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the edit target, the freshly generated upright FRONT face of Base 02. Make ONE targeted correction to the front silhouette's aspect ratio: its outer rounded rectangle must be 0.96 wide for 1.18 high (width/height 0.81356), rather than the current roughly 0.773. On this square image the object should be about 896 pixels wide and 1102 pixels high, centered. This is a true orthographic view normal to the complete playing TOP of the upright object, long axis vertical, zero tilt, no perspective. Keep the same empty flat dark gray stone center, narrow amber groove, exact six bronze dividers at four corners and middle of each long side, bronze edge design, neutral illumination, pure white background and subtle surface texture. No other changes. No sidewall or underside, no shadows, no labels or dimension marks. The object is only 0.04 m deep; preserve this conceptual depth, not visible from the exact front. Output one square image.

Correct only the profile silhouette dimensions. The object is a thin upright stone plaque observed exactly edge on from its LEFT, camera -X, no tilt or perspective. Reduce the profile's width to about 45 percent of the reference width. Match the FRONT's vertical extent and position: approximately 38 pixels wide by 1103 pixels tall on a square 1254-pixel canvas.
